summary: Use runtime semantics for general property deletion because descriptors, arrays, proxies, and strict-mode failures are observable.

target.notes: Evaluate base/key once, ToPropertyKey as required, invoke internal [[Delete]], honor configurable descriptors and Proxy deleteProperty traps, and return a Boolean or throw in strict contexts as specified.

semantics.prototype: inherited property is not deleted from prototype
semantics.array_index: deleting an element can create a hole without changing length

caveats: delete is not Dictionary.Remove semantics in the presence of property descriptors/proxies.
Deleting an unqualified identifier has separate early-error/runtime rules depending on grammar/mode.

tests.name: normal configurable property deletion
tests.input: const o={x:1}; console.log(delete o.x, 'x' in o);

tests.name: edge array delete keeps length
tests.input: const a=[1,2,3]; console.log(delete a[1], a.length, 1 in a);
